high_level_description: The image depicts a dramatic scene set on the ocean. The focal point is a large, glowing blue structure that appears to be erupting from the water. This structure has multiple jagged, spiky protrusions that are illuminated with a bright blue light, giving it an otherworldly appearance. The base of the structure seems to be composed of dark, rocky material, which contrasts sharply with the vibrant blue of the glowing elements. The background shows a cloudy sky, suggesting overcast weather conditions.
